design.density: Compact workspace surfaces with metadata and machine evidence at least 12px, using natural font widths

patterns: Immutable plan versions and persisted dry-run evidence

must: Preserve one source, one target and the 1,000-record limit
Use existing CSS tokens and primitives
Show keyboard focus and responsive layouts

decisions: User-confirmed Linear navigation and Supabase data controls replace the former customs-declaration identity.
Manrope carries interface copy; JetBrains Mono carries machine evidence, at natural font widths with metadata and evidence at least 12px.

Neutral light and layered graphite dark surfaces use deeper emerald action fills with white text, brighter teal links and focus, dedicated violet approval fills, quieter jade accepted-record fills and separate semantic status tints.
Operator identity, recent runs, New test and theme controls live in the bottom dock; mobile uses two rows.
Flat bordered sections reserve shadows for history menus and dialogs.
